text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, *cough*. A birthday... in other 
words, today is a day to let loose and 
have a blast! So, I came to invite you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-chan, you're curious about "that", 
aren't you? The talk-of-the-town "Giant 
Hamburger Tower on Niagara Falls Cheese" 
in front of the station!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Rice flour buns! Packed with veggies! Its 
nutritional balance is unbeatable! I 
figured this might pique your interest, 
Ikuno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As you pointed out, I was indeed curious. 
However... Given my clumsy eating habits, 
the hurdle was too high. I couldn't risk 
making a mess in the restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's all right! There's nothing to fear if 
we all eat together!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally. I mean, at that level, even 
I can't eat it neatly~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Most of all, it's a birthday! So it's fine 
if the burger falls over! It's fine if it 
gets all over your cheeks!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if our hands and clothes 
get all sticky! So let's the three of us 
dig in with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Both of you... Right... Then, if you 
insist. Please let me take on the 
challenge――!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, that's the spirit, that's the 
spirit~! All right, let's go have a 
blast~!
